**Finding submitted — WARRANTY: deviation (fallback cure).**

- **What exists:** Section 5 gives only a knowledge-qualified legal-compliance warranty (p0024), an authority/rights warranty (p0025), and a non-infringement warranty (p0026); Section 1(b) requires professional and workmanlike performance (p0005). Sections 4 and 7 contain no acceptance or warranty-remedy mechanic despite the Section 4 heading.
- **Gap:** no conformance warranty for software or Services, no warranty period, and no repair/replace/refund remedy — while implied warranties of merchantability and fitness are disclaimed (p0030). This fails every material fallback element.
- **Cure:** one inserted subparagraph 5(f) — 90 days for software deliverables conforming to documentation/Specifications, 30 days for Services, with repair, replacement or refund at Company's election. The disclaimer already preserves express warranties, so it was left verbatim, and no preferred-only extras (12 months, malicious code, compliance-with-laws) were volunteered.
